root_cause.gate_conflict: The two unweakened gates have a very narrow overlap that GPT Image 2 could not hit in 5 bounded attempts. Gate (a)'s hardened full-frame VLM is FAIL-CLOSED: it requires Kai's face -- including the lower third (nose/mouth/chin/jaw) -- visible enough to affirmatively ground 2-3 specific-identity features, and FAILs on occlusion or a far turn. Gate (b) requires Kai's mouth to be NOT camera-readable. Any pose that hid the mouth enough for (b) (arm occlusion in attempt 1, or a strong turn) hid enough face to trip the fail-closed identity gate (a); any pose verifiable enough for (a) (attempts 2-5) left the mouth camera-readable and failed (b).
root_cause.not_a_logical_impossibility: Attempts 4 and 5 passed identity AND both continuity pairs with only composition failing, so the target region is reachable in principle (a moderate three-quarter with the lips just foreshortened enough); it is a generation-controllability gap, not a strict contradiction, but it was not achieved within the 5-attempt budget.
root_cause.design_tension_with_delta: step38_sb_003_composition_delta_proposal.v1.json specifies for the END frame identity_requirements.Kai.visibility.face_required=false with identity_anchored_by=sb_003.start_frame ('Full frontal face is no longer required for the end frame because identity is proven by the start frame'). Acceptance criterion (a), however, requires the augmented identity review -- which verifies the face on the frame under review -- to PASS for BOTH visible characters on the END frame. These are in tension. Resolving that tension is a GATE-DESIGN decision and must be made by a human; it was NOT resolved here by weakening the identity gate.
